# VOA News

> Voice of America's multilingual news organization providing international coverage, breaking news, and journalism across 48 language services.

VOA News is a U.S. government-funded international news organization covering U.S. politics, global affairs, and world events through multiple platforms including web, television, radio, and digital services in dozens of languages.

## Key Topics

- Voice of America
- International News
- US News & Politics
- Breaking News
- World Affairs
- Multilingual Coverage
- Russia
- Ukraine
- Iran
- Trump
- Senate
- US Government
- Documentary
- Current Events

## News & Coverage

- [VOA - Voice of America English News](https://www.voanews.com): Voice of America homepage with international news coverage
- [USA News - Latest from the United States - VOA News](https://www.voanews.com/usa): US news section covering Congress, White House, Pentagon coverage
- [Starmer: Russia must yield to peace](https://www.voanews.com/a/starmer-sooner-or-later-russia-must-yield-to-peace/8011681.html): News article on Ukraine-Russia ceasefire negotiations
- [Senate averts government shutdown](https://www.voanews.com/a/us-government-shutdown-likely-averted-democrats-fracture/8011226.html): News article on US Senate spending resolution and shutdown
- [US to expel South Africa ambassador](https://www.voanews.com/a/us-to-expel-south-africa-ambassador-as-relations-deteriorate/8011493.html): News article on US-South Africa diplomatic tensions
- [News article covering international affairs and US politics](https://www.voanews.com/p/6195.html): Breaking news coverage of international affairs and US politics

- [VOA Global Coverage](https://projects.voanews.com/global2): Real-time aggregator of VOA's 48 language services coverage

- [VOA Farsi](https://ir.voanews.com): VOA Farsi language service covering Iran and Middle East
